verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a public API Reference and an official MCP server, and serves agent-oriented markdown versions of both pages, so an external agent has documented first-party entry points into the platform. The evidence pack only gives page titles and pointers, though; it never shows what these APIs actually query, and the OpenAPI spec probes returned 404. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the API/MCP server can query metrics, logs, and traces specifically, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent debugging production through these interfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production
